I've just started (trying) to play guitar and found this to be a helpful intro.

Hopefully it can help anyone else who has just picked up a guitar and wants to get started.

I would also very much recommend either the Mel Bay Modern Guitar Method, Grade 1, or the Hal Leonard Guitar Method, book 1. Hal Leonard is a bit more gentle than Mel Bay, but either one will set a new player off with a firm foundation. I also have to mention the Aaron Shearer classical guitar technique, however, IMHO, it should be used in conjunction with Jerry Willard's 50 Easy Classical Guitar Solos. The reason for that is that many of the exercises in the Aaron Shearer book are duets meant to be played with the instructor, which don't work well from the perspective of someone trying to learn on their own.
